concerns.text: Task T007 states: "if any VIF ≥ 5, drops the covariate with the highest VIF and records the final set in `results/vif_report.csv`". This directly weakens FR‑004, which mandates a mass‑univariate mixed‑effects model **including all covariates** (Age, Sex, Mean FD). Dropping a covariate changes the model specification and violates the functional requirement.

The Constitution (VI) requires a robustness re‑analysis restricted to low‑motion participants (mean FD < 0.2 mm). No task in the list implements this low‑motion subset analysis, constituting a constitution violation.
FR‑006 mandates that all statistical findings be explicitly framed as associational, not causal. No task references or enforces this framing requirement, leaving the acceptance criterion uncovered.
